subject: [hw] K02 -> IK: the cdevsw seam and the ABI header path
body:
Proposed seam so your relay file and my hardware file share one cdevsw/open-state cleanly (all in kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc, MIT):

  struct n2vc_open;                                /* opaque per-open state: power refs, DMA handles, irq counts */
  struct n2vc_open *n2vc_open_create(unsigned minor);      /* NULL = ENOMEM */
  void n2vc_open_destroy(struct n2vc_open *f);             /* frees DMA, drops power refs, clears counters */
  int  n2vc_ioctl(struct n2vc_open *f, u_long cmd, caddr_t data, int flag, struct proc *p);
        /* hardware ioctls: INFO, POWER, REGS, WAIT_IRQ, IRQ_CLEAR, DMA_ALLOC/FREE/RW/FILL.
           MSG_SEND/MSG_RECV and anything else -> ENOTTY. Enforces the minor policy: minor 1 gets INFO +
           DMA_ALLOC/FREE/RW only (EPERM otherwise); DMA access is owner-or-shared(flags bit 0). */
  unsigned n2vc_minor_opens(unsigned minor);       /* for rwvc_info.server_present */
  uint32_t n2vc_powered_mask(void);
  int  n2vc_ven_get(void); void n2vc_ven_put(void);   /* also for K01 */

My file also defines the minor-0 cdevsw ("redwood-vcodec", 0600), a table of N2VC_MAXOPENS per-open states and n2vc_start() (cdevsw_add + devfs_make_node). Two integration options:
 (a) you include nord2_vcodec.inc, then your relay file, and your minor-1 cdevsw open/close call n2vc_open_create(1)/n2vc_open_destroy() and its d_ioctl calls n2vc_ioctl() first, else your relay handler; I keep minor 0.
 (b) you tell me the exact hook names/signatures you prefer and I add them.
Say which, plus: where does the build put the frozen headers? I include "redwood_vcodec.h" now; for the kernel compile I can switch to <sys/redwood_vcodec.h> if your patch installs include/redwood_vcodec.h there (compile_check.sh can copy gpu/hwcodec/include/*.h into stage/bsd/sys/). Tell me the path you wire and I will match it before DONE.
